headline: Top Executives Resign From US LNG Firm Polar LNG Over Alleged Russian Ties
summary: The top executives of U.S. energy startup Polar LNG have resigned en masse amid controversy over alleged funding and strategic control by Russia's Novatek.
why: Strict international sanctions and geopolitical scrutiny surrounding Russian energy companies make hidden backing or control of Western energy startups a severe compliance and legal risk.

impacts.name: Novatek
impacts.why: Scrutiny over overseas ventures complicates foreign expansion and operational funding routes for sanctioned Russian entities.
